key_highlights: ASX mixed: energy and big miners rally but oil-driven slide pressure and iron ore weakness cap gains
BHP under pressure as iron ore prices crumble, prompting strategic review
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA unlikely to intervene
Super-for-housing policy under Bragg review signals potential superannuation reform
Gold sector active with multiple ASX miners hitting milestones (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Aureka)
Gas crisis divides energy industry; tanker wars unlikely to suppress oil prices
Consumer stress intensifies: mortgage costs driving second jobs, Australians feel poorer
Construction sector under stress with Bathla suspensions signalling broader industry turmoil
AUD stronger on rising oil; geopolitical risk elevated (Iran, Trump threats)

sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG, but gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto) and uranium (Infini) show strength. Gold price elevated on Trump/geopolitical risk.
sectors.implications: Rotate from iron ore exposure to gold and uranium. BHP.AX strategic review risk. Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Energy stocks rally on rising oil prices and gas crisis narrative. Tanker wars unlikely to suppress oil. Gas supply concerns create domestic pricing pressure.
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), Origin (ORG.AX). Gas crisis may boost domestic gas producers but hurt consumers.

sectors.trend: Housing price acceleration in falls raises NPL concerns. RBA unlikely to cut rates, keeping mortgage stress elevated. Super-for-housing review could reshape deposit flows.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face credit risk from property downturn. Super reform may redirect superannuation flows.

sectors.trend: Property industry facing 'GFC moment' with accelerating price falls. RBA not expected to intervene. Construction sector stressed (Bathla suspensions).
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure. Construction names (WTC.AX, CGC.AX) face project delays and insolvency risk.

sectors.trend: Consumer squeeze intensifies with mortgage costs driving second jobs. Tobacco tax debate may boost health spending. CSL.AX stable but broader consumer discretionary weak.
sectors.implications: Defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) favoured. Healthcare (CSL.AX, SGH.AX) resilient. Tobacco tax may pressure BHP-owned tobacco assets.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control. AI data centre buildout continues globally. Domestic tech limited but media consolidation active.
sectors.implications: Seven (SVL.AX) governance shift. AI theme (TSS, global) supports data infrastructure plays.

key_themes: Iron ore structural weakness vs gold/uranium strength in mining
Housing market correction accelerating without RBA rescue
Super-for-housing policy debate reshaping retirement savings
Geopolitical risk premium (Iran, Trump) supporting gold and energy
Gas supply crisis creating domestic energy pricing tension
AUD strength on oil offsetting some commodity weakness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market acceleration in price falls
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property-linked exposure; favour cash-flow defensive equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse impacting BHP/FMG earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX; rotate to gold miners
Maintain gold and energy hedges; monitor oil price volatility
Avoid small-cap construction; monitor WTC.AX, CGC.AX order books

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy inaction amid property stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prepare for prolonged higher-for-longer rate environment; favour fixed income

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Gas supply crisis and energy price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WDS.AX, ORG.AX gas pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and Trump-driven gold price strength
opportunities.rationale: Multiple ASX gold hits (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Aureka $8.9M acquisition) signal sector momentum; geopolitical risk supports gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil rally and gas crisis
opportunities.rationale: Energy stocks rallying; tanker wars won't suppress oil; gas crisis supports domestic producers

opportunities.recommendation: Uranium exploration play on Infini 7.5% source discovery
opportunities.rationale: High-grade uranium discovery in Canada supports sector sentiment; nuclear energy demand structural

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce BHP and iron ore exposure; rotate to gold within materials
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crumbling, BHP strategic review risk; gold offers commodity exposure with safe-haven premium

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property and construction; favour defensive consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing GFC moment, Bathla suspensions, RBA inaction; WES/WOW provide defensive cash flow

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash allocation; RBA unlikely to cut, keeping rates elevated
defensive_moves.rationale: Prolonged higher-for-longer environment; housing stress without policy relief; consumer squeeze ongoing

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Energy and gold support index but iron ore weakness, housing stress, and consumer squeeze cap upside. AUD strength on oil is a partial offset. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Trump) add volatility. Expect 1-2% downside risk on any escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in mining mix (iron ore to gold/uranium) supports selective outperformance. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months without RBA intervention. Super-for-housing reform could reshape financial sector flows. Consumer pressure persists through 2026-27. Gold and energy remain structural beneficiaries.

Australian CPI and housing data releases
US midterms impact on global risk appetite
